title: Forcepoint Email Security or Proofpoint Email Protection: Data Protection vs Broad Email Defence
excerpt: Two email security gateways compared for organisations that must stop inbound threats and control outbound data. Forcepoint has long emphasised data loss prevention; Proofpoint is one of the most widely deployed email security vendors.
verdict: Forcepoint is a strong choice for sensitive sectors such as government and finance where controlling outbound data is the top priority. Proofpoint is the more widely deployed general-purpose email security platform and the safer default for most businesses focused on inbound phishing and malware.
